# Sedorium — The Five Thrones

> A free dark fantasy web novel by Sam Nowroozi Larki. Broken thrones and lost souls, told across 67 chapters with a new chapter every 3 days.

Sedorium follows druids, shapeshifters, oathbound factions and ancient kingdoms across five nations. Every chapter is free to read online, alongside a codex of characters and lore, a world map, illustrated manga panels and a reader forum.

## Pages

- [Home](/): Series overview, latest chapter and where to start.
- [All chapters](/chapters): Full chapter list, free to read.
- [Chapter 1: A Grim Introduction](/chapters/1): The opening chapter.
- [Codex](/characters): Characters, places, creatures and lore.
- [World map](/world): The five nations and the lands between.
- [Manga](/manga): Illustrated panels from the novel.
- [About](/about): About the novel and the author.
